inputs.description: Select the vcpkg-configuration variant to activate

tasks.label: Tsk:SelectVcpkgConfig
tasks.detail: Copy the picked vcpkg-configuration variant (public|evs) into vcpkg-configuration.json before configure

tasks.label: Tsk:KillLocal
tasks.detail: Kill local onbings-vista-service/tests instances before building (avoids LNK1168 file lock)

tasks.label: Tsk:BldLocalDebug
tasks.detail: Kill local instances then build the active CMake preset for local debugging

tasks.label: Tsk:MkDir
tasks.detail: Create remote directories to deploy package and ut data under linux

tasks.label: Tsk:KillAll
tasks.detail: Kill specific gdbserver process listening on ${config:cppGdbPort}

tasks.label: Tsk:DeployDebugArtifact
tasks.detail: Copy all built artifacts (bin, lib, data) to remote directory using rsync

tasks.label: Tsk:DeployReleaseArtifact
tasks.detail: Copy all built artifacts (bin, lib, data) to remote directory using rsync

tasks.label: Tsk:PrismTestCpp
tasks.detail: Debug vista Test Cpp with C++ gdb Debugger (auto debug/release from active CMake preset)
args: preset='${command:cmake.activeConfigurePresetName}'; preset_lc="${preset,,}"; if [[ "$preset_lc" =~ -r(e)?lease$ ]]; then build_flavor='release'; build_dir='all-p6x-release'; else build_flavor='debug'; build_dir='all-p6x-debug'; fi; echo "[TASK] Active configure preset: $preset"; echo "[TASK] Selected flavor: $build_flavor ($build_dir)"; ssh ${config:targetUser}@${config:targetHost} 'pkill -f "gdbserver.*${config:cppGdbPort}" || killall -9 onbings-vista-tests || true' || true; ssh ${config:targetUser}@${config:targetHost} 'mkdir -p /tmp/${env:USER}_vista/lib && mkdir -p /tmp/${env:USER}_vista/bin && mkdir -p /tmp/${env:USER}_vista/data && mkdir -p /tmp/${env:USER}_vista/bin/assets && mkdir -p /tmp/${env:USER}_vista/python_package_1'; rsync -av "${workspaceFolder}/out/build/${build_dir}/binaries/bin/" "${config:targetUser}@${config:targetHost}:/tmp/${env:USER}_vista/bin/" && rsync -av "${workspaceFolder}/out/build/${build_dir}/binaries/lib/" "${config:targetUser}@${config:targetHost}:/tmp/${env:USER}_vista/lib/" && rsync -av "${workspaceFolder}/code/sources/onbings-vista-lib/assets/" "${config:targetUser}@${config:targetHost}:/tmp/${env:USER}_vista/bin/assets/"; ssh -t ${config:targetUser}@${config:targetHost} 'cd /tmp/${env:USER}_vista/bin && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=./assets/axelera/venv/lib && gdbserver localhost:${config:cppGdbPort} /tmp/${env:USER}_vista/bin/onbings-vista-tests'
